name: sim_cvc5_capability
purpose: Tool-capability isolation probe for cvc5 -- SAT/UNSAT parity with z3.

pytorch.reason: not used: this cvc5 capability fixture exercises SMT solver checks, not tensor autodiff or torch kernels.

pyg.reason: not used: no graph Data object, edge index, message passing, batching, or graph pooling API is exercised.

z3.reason: not used: this fixture isolates cvc5; z3 parity and agreement are covered by separate tool-integration receipts.

cvc5.reason: capability under test -- SAT/UNSAT parity with z3 on shared encodings

sympy.reason: not used: terms are constructed through cvc5 APIs directly rather than symbolic algebra conversion.

clifford.reason: not used: no Clifford basis, multivector product, rotor, or grade projection appears in this SMT fixture.

geomstats.reason: not used: no manifold metric, geodesic, or Lie group geometry API is part of this proof-layer probe.

e3nn.reason: not used: no equivariant neural operation, representation tensor, or learned layer is exercised.

rustworkx.reason: not used: no DAG, graph traversal, shortest path, or dependency graph API is involved.

xgi.reason: not used: no hypergraph incidence, hyperedge membership, or higher-order relation is represented.

toponetx.reason: not used: no cell complex, simplicial complex, Hasse graph, or incidence matrix is exercised.

gudhi.reason: not used: no persistent homology, simplex tree, filtration, or Betti computation is needed.

kcbs_c5_bound_unsat.detail: C5 max independent set = 2; sum>=3 must be UNSAT (parity with z3 probe)

operation_sequence: construct fresh cvc5 solvers with declared logics
build Boolean, integer, and real cvc5 sorts and constants
assert a Boolean conjunction and check SAT
assert a linear integer system and read model values
encode a five-cycle binary exclusion bound with impossible sum
run adjacent negative fixtures for direct contradiction, tautology satisfiability, and ill-formed non-Boolean assertion
run boundary fixtures for empty assertion set, contradictory integer ranges, and multi-variable witness extraction

carrier_topology.carrier: finite cvc5 SMT constraint systems over Boolean, integer, and real sorts
boundary_fixtures: x greater than zero and x less than zero

observable.primary: cvc5 checkSat result values SAT or UNSAT
secondary: witness validity for bounded integer model

pass: linear integer system is SAT with x=7 and y=3
five-cycle exclusion with sum at least three is UNSAT
direct p and not p contradiction is UNSAT
tautology p or not p is SAT
multi-variable witness satisfies lower bounds and sum constraint
fail: model extraction returns wrong integer values

graveyards.name: direct_boolean_contradiction
graveyards.change: assert p and not p in the same cvc5 solver

graveyards.name: ill_formed_non_boolean_assertion
graveyards.change: assert an integer term as a formula
graveyards.expected_death: cvc5 raises instead of accepting the assertion

baselines.name: manual_boolean_truth_table
baselines.role: baseline for p and not p contradiction and p or not p tautology

baselines.name: manual_five_cycle_independent_set_bound
baselines.role: baseline that the maximum independent set of C5 has size 2

baselines.name: manual_linear_system_solution
baselines.role: baseline solving x+y=10 and x-y=4 as x=7, y=3

alternative_formulations: Z3 QF_LIA and Boolean encoding of the same SAT/UNSAT fixtures
truth-table enumeration for the Boolean fixtures
integer linear programming formulation of the five-cycle exclusion bound
out_of_scope: no bridge, axis, engine, or scientific coupling claim
demotion_condition: Demote to blocked tool capability if cvc5 is unavailable, any SAT/UNSAT parity check fails, or strict receipt lint fails.
promotion_condition: May only support later cvc5 tool-lego or tool-tool packets after those packets provide their own admitted receipts.
next_lego_target: Use as a prerequisite receipt for bounded cvc5 proof micro packets.
blocked_until: No broader claim until a downstream packet cites this receipt and passes its own stage gate.
